restore.description: The app whose volumes and secrets are restored, and where the secrets are saved.

namespace.description: The namespace of the app, where its PVCs and its secrets are. Required, set by the `apps` chart.

secretsBackupSchedule.description: The cron schedule of the CronJob `secrets-backup`, which saves the secrets generated for the app.

s3Secret.description: The secret, in the namespace of the release, with the key of the bucket of the secrets: `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` and `AWS_ENDPOINTS`. The secrets are not handled when it does not exist.

secretsBucket.description: The bucket of the secrets, under the prefix `secrets/`.

secretsRegion.description: The region of the bucket (`garage` for Garage).

scriptConfigMap.description: The ConfigMap with the script `files/restore.sh`, one by namespace of app. Set by the loader.

scriptHash.description: The hash of the script, part of the name of the Job: a new script is a new Job (the spec of a Job is immutable). Set by the loader.
